title: Spring exit speed
description: Essential: Correctly computes the block's speed at the moment it leaves the spring using conservation of energy.

title: Incline entry speed
description: Essential: Correctly determines the block's speed when it first reaches the incline, given the condition that it just returns to the top after the collision.

title: Minimum travel distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum distance the block travels on the incline without leaving it.

title: Circular motion condition
description: Important: Applies the condition for circular motion at the top of the track to find the minimum required speed.

title: Energy-work analysis
description: Important: Correctly uses the work-energy theorem to account for friction on the incline and energy changes on the circular track.

title: Geometry and trigonometry
description: Optional: Correctly uses the geometry of the setup (e.g., height changes on the circular track) in energy equations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (meters, seconds, joules) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the sign for the work done by friction on the incline.

title: Forgetting collision rebound
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for the fact the block rebounds with the same speed after hitting the baffle.
